   Psalms 51:4 Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
>> Psalms 51:5 Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
   Psalms 51:6 Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
   Psalms 51:7 Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

verses.shown: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.context:
Psalms 51:7 Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
   Psalms 51:8 Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
>> Psalms 51:9 Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
   Psalms 51:10 Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
   Psalms 51:11 Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
